name: com.witchworkshop.dialogue
description: Runs dialogue graphs exported by the Witch Workshop web editor: branching dialogue, choices, conditions, variables (global and local), game events, character portraits and replaceable uGUI/TextMeshPro views.

samples.description: One-component demo: a customer visits the workshop and asks for a potion. Builds a basic UI and placeholder portraits at runtime.
Example handlers for GiveItem, OpenShop, UnlockRecipe, StartQuest, CompleteQuest and ChangeScene against minimal interfaces, plus the Apprentice Quest dialogue.
